description: Machine-readable catalog of every JSON-RPC error code the wa daemon emits. Bands: -32700/-32600..-32603 protocol, -32000..-32010 socket server, -32011..-32099 app/policy preconditions, -32100..-32199 policy/idempotency, -32200..-32299 rate-limit, -32300..-32399 media/content.

errors.name: parse_error
errors.remediation: Fix the JSON framing; one JSON-RPC 2.0 object per line.

errors.name: invalid_request
errors.remediation: Include jsonrpc:"2.0", a non-empty id, and a method string.

errors.name: method_not_found
errors.remediation: Check the method name against docs/manual.md section 6; the daemon may be older than the client or the feature is flag-gated in config.toml.

errors.name: invalid_params
errors.remediation: Compare the params shape with the method reference in docs/manual.md.

errors.name: internal_error
errors.remediation: Inspect daemon logs; retry once after checking wa status.

errors.name: peer_cred_rejected
errors.remediation: Connect from the same UID that owns the daemon socket.

errors.name: backpressure
errors.remediation: The daemon is shedding load; back off and retry.

errors.name: shutdown_in_progress
errors.remediation: The daemon is stopping; retry after it restarts.

errors.name: request_timeout
errors.remediation: Re-issue the request; for wait, widen timeoutMs.

errors.name: oversized_message
errors.remediation: Keep one frame under the documented size cap; chunk large payloads via media upload.

errors.name: subscription_closed
errors.remediation: Re-subscribe; the daemon dropped subscriptions during reload/shutdown.

errors.name: pong_timeout
errors.remediation: Connection liveness failed; reconnect.

errors.name: stream_drop
errors.remediation: Event buffer overflowed; reconcile from history (messages.list) and re-subscribe.

errors.name: protocol_mismatch
errors.remediation: Upgrade the wa CLI/client to match the daemon protoVersion (system.hello).

errors.name: not_paired
errors.remediation: Run wa pair on the daemon host and scan the QR code.

errors.name: not_allowlisted
errors.remediation: Operator must run: wa allow add <jid> --actions send (default-deny policy).

errors.name: rate_limited_soft
errors.remediation: Per-second budget hit; wait at least one second. Budgets are non-overridable.

errors.name: warmup_active
errors.remediation: Fresh session ramp (reduced caps for 14 days) — wait; do not attempt to bypass.

errors.name: invalid_jid
errors.remediation: Use digits-with-country-code or a full JID like 5511999999999@s.whatsapp.net; resolve names via contacts.search first.

errors.name: message_too_large
errors.remediation: Shorten the body or send as a document via sendMedia.

errors.name: not_on_whatsapp
errors.remediation: Verify the number; the pre-send deliverability gate rejected it.

errors.name: disconnected
errors.remediation: Daemon link is down; check wa status and daemon logs, then retry.

errors.name: unauthorized
errors.remediation: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>; verify the token is valid, unexpired and has the needed scope.

errors.name: policy_refused
errors.remediation: The default-deny allowlist refused the action; operator must grant it with wa allow add.

errors.name: idempotency_collision
errors.remediation: Same idempotency key with different payload; mint a new request id.

errors.name: idempotency_key_conflict
errors.remediation: Reuse the original payload for this key, or mint a new key.

errors.name: draft_state
errors.remediation: Fetch the draft (draft.get) and act on its current state; only pending_review drafts can be approved or rejected.

errors.name: media_too_large
errors.remediation: Compress or shrink the attachment below the documented cap.

errors.name: schedule_in_past
errors.remediation: Use a future fireAt timestamp, or send immediately.

errors.name: embeddings_disabled
errors.remediation: Enable embeddings=true in config.toml and restart the daemon.

errors.name: labels_unsupported
errors.remediation: Labels need a WhatsApp Business account AND labels=true in config.toml.

errors.name: transcriber_not_configured
errors.remediation: Start the daemon with WA_TRANSCRIBER=whispercpp|hear|groq.

errors.name: transcribe_failed
errors.remediation: Transient transcriber failure; retry once, then check daemon logs.

errors.name: message_not_found
errors.remediation: Verify the message id via thread.get or messages.list; history may need wa sync force.

errors.name: rate_limited
errors.remediation: Minute/day budget exhausted; wait for the window to roll. Budgets are non-overridable by design.

errors.name: media_too_large_protocol
errors.remediation: Attachment exceeds the WhatsApp protocol cap; shrink it.

errors.name: unsupported_message_type
errors.remediation: This message kind has no media payload to fetch.

errors.name: media_not_cached
errors.remediation: Run media.download for the message id to lazy-fetch, then retry.

errors.name: webhook_not_found
errors.remediation: List endpoints with wa webhook list (or deliveries with wa webhook deliveries) and use an existing id.
